outcome: The filesystem cache covers the whole workspace so a monorepo does not re-stat files it has already seen.

acceptance_criteria.text: Files under the workspace root are served from the cache rather than re-stat'ed.

expected_verification.assertion: a repeated resolution of a workspace file does not stat it again

acceptance_criteria.text: A file that changes on disk is invalidated from the cache, wherever in the workspace it sits.

expected_verification.assertion: renaming a file outside the project root but inside the workspace invalidates its cache entry

data_impact: None. An in-memory cache in the dev server.
